scan_table_check.description: If a Script Include contains a client-callable class derived from AbstractAjaxProcessor then any use of DevTools' GetParam() should contain the 3rd parameter "this" to ensure that the parameter is taken from the class' getParameter() function.
scan_table_check.name: CodeSanity - GetParam with this
scan_table_check.resolution_details: Add "this" as the 3rd parameter to each GetParam() call within the client-callable class. For example: GetParam("my_param", IsValidSysId, this)
scan_table_check.short_description: Client-callable Script Includes must pass "this" when using GetParam()
